comment: Fixtures that Relics adds, in the format of the server fixtures in ../silo. They were written by hand from docs/architecture/playback-protocol-v3.md of the server.

fixtures.name: playback_start_transcode
fixtures.scenario: A HEVC 10-bit file that the server transcodes to HLS from a resume point at 600 s.

fixtures.name: playback_start_adaptation_unavailable
fixtures.scenario: The file cannot play directly and the server does not allow transcoding.

fixtures.name: playback_start_unknown_outcome
fixtures.scenario: A newer server answers with an outcome that this app does not know.

fixtures.name: playback_replan_failure_recovery
fixtures.scenario: The direct stream failed at 3600 s. The replan after the failure moves the session to a transcode from that position.
